blocks.text: Munh khulte hi jo khali jagah (cavity) hai use oral cavity kehte hain. Hont (lips) skeletal muscle ke bane hain, in mein khoon ki bohat si naliyan aur mehsoos karne wali bohat si nerve endings hoti hain. Hont chabate waqt khane ko munh mein rokte hain aur bolne mein awaz ko badalne (phonation) mein bhi kaam aate hain. Oral cavity ke aham kaam yeh hain:

Khane ka intikhab (selection of food): zaban (tongue) muscle ki bani hai aur apne taste buds (zaiqa mehsoos karne wale hisson) se khana chunne mein kaam aati hai. Khana munh mein aata hai to us ka zaiqa chakha aur use chhoo kar mehsoos kiya jata hai. Agar zaiqa ya boo buri ho, ya khane mein haddi ya mitti jaisi sakht cheez ho, to use bahar nikal diya jata hai. Soonghne aur dekhne ki hiss bhi khana chunne mein madad karti hai.

Mechanical digestion (khane ko tod kar chhota karna): daant khane ko chaba kar todte hain; ise mastication (chabana) kehte hain. Chabane se khana chhote, sambhalne ke qabil tukdon mein badal jata hai aur us ki surface area (bahar ki satah) barh jati hai, is liye enzymes behtar kaam karte hain.
bold: Mechanical digestion (khane ko tod kar chhota karna):

blocks.text: Chemical digestion (enzymes se hazma): chabane ke saath saath salivary glands apna juice, saliva (thook), munh mein dalte hain. Talu (palate), zaban aur gaal chabaye hue khane ko saliva mein milate hain. Salivary glands ke teen jode hain: sublingual glands (zaban ke neeche), submaxillary glands (jabdon ke peeche) aur parotid glands (kaanon ke aage).

blocks.alt: Sar ka pehlu se manzar. Parotid gland kaan ke aage aur neeche hai aur us ki nali aage munh tak jati hai; Submaxillary gland jabre ke kone ke neeche; Sublingual gland zaban ke neeche munh ke farsh mein.

blocks.text: Saliva mein pani aur mucus (chikna madda) hota hai jo khane ko geela aur chikna banata hai. Is mein bicarbonate ions bhi hote hain jo munh ke chemicals ka asar halka (buffer) karte hain, aur thiocyanate ions jo jaraseem (microorganisms) ko maarte hain. Kitab ke mutabiq taaza saliva alkaline (pH 8) hota hai, magar jaldi CO₂ kho kar pH 6 ka ho jata hai. Saliva mein ek enzyme, salivary amylase, bhi hota hai jo polysaccharides (starch aur glycogen) ko kuch had tak disaccharide (maltose) mein tod deta hai. Munh mein mechanical aur chemical digestion ke baad khana ek chhota, geela gola ban jata hai jise bolus kehte hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teen jode yaad rakhein: parotid (kaan ke aage, sab se bada), submaxillary (jabde ke neeche) aur sublingual (zaban ke neeche). Teenon ka juice, saliva, naliyon ke zariye munh mein aata hai.
